description: This file defines the RevisionRevertForm class in Drupal, which provides a form for reverting entity revisions within the Drupal content management system. It includes methods for form handling, revision preparation, and entity management.

classes.name: RevisionRevertForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for reverting an entity revision, providing confirmation and revision handling functionalities.

methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as date formatter, bundle info, messenger, time, and current user.

methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.description: Returns the base form ID based on the entity type.
